description: One purchase order in full: supplier, outlet, status, and every line — what was ORDERED and what has actually ARRIVED, per item, across each delivery. Answers 'what is on this order', 'what is still outstanding', 'did the price change from what we agreed'. Money appears twice on every writable field: the formatted one (CA$12.50) is for reading out to the merchant, the *Amount twin (12.50) is what update_purchase_order accepts back. The `ordered` block is the agreed order; each entry in `receipts` is one delivery booked against it, with its invoice number. Compare an item’s ordered quantity against the sum of its received quantities to see what is still owed — receiving more than ordered is allowed, so an overage is real, not an error. ALWAYS CALL THIS AFTER receive_purchase_order instead of retrying the receive: it is the way to confirm what was booked.

purchaseOrderId.description: Purchase order id from get_purchase_orders — not a PO number
